subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Leo found an old bike behind his grandfather's house.”?
options: The old bridge no longer does its first job, but it still connects people.
Grandpa Lin bought his first smartphone last month.
At first, he wanted to fix it quickly.
"That bike carried me to my first job."

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The old bridge no longer does its first job, but it still connects people.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Grandpa Lin bought his first smartphone last month.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「At first, he wanted to fix it quickly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「'That bike carried me to my first job.'」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「'That bike carried me to my first job.'」，答案為「'That bike carried me to my first job.'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「'That bike carried me to my first job.'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
